english:
[on that] day, after: Scripture [Reading] and "For the Souls" [hymn]. Likewise in the evening as on ordinary fast days, and not...

Tuesday. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 1 [ah]: "Who of the same essence."
Midday Messedi: Psalm 127 [128]: "Blessed are all."
Prophet Ezekiel 18:20: "The righteousness of the righteous" to verse 23: "from his evil way and live."

Wednesday. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 2 [bz]: "You who are powerful in all." Today perform the order of repentance, and begin "Lord Almighty" in the morning and at midday, and the Sunrise [Arevagal] hymns; likewise at midday, the Great Litany, the Prayers, and the "Oghormia" songs. And after: "Bow down" and "Save me." Midday Messedi: Psalm 37 [38]: "Forsake me not, O Lord my God." Scripture Exodus 1:1 [1:1–10?]: "These are the names of the sons of Israel" to [2:10?]: "drew him out of the water." Prophet Joel 1:14: "Sanctify a fast" to verse 20: "the beauty of the wilderness." Psalm 50 [51]: "Have mercy on me, O God," say the responses in full. And the others according to the order. But in the evening, the Peace Service, "Look with Love," and "We entreat You," and then "For the Souls," and they are dismissed. This is the order of the fast on plain days until Palm Sunday.

Thursday. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 1 [ad]: "Blessed are You."
Midday Messedi: Psalm 70 [71]: "Cast me not off, O Lord."
Epistle Romans 6:3: "Know you not" to verse 14: "but under grace."

Friday. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 2 [bz]: "Blessed are You forever." Midday Messedi: Psalm 118 [119]: "Let my cry come near." Scripture Deuteronomy 6:4: "Hear, O Israel" to verse 10 [6:15/7:10]: "but will repay them to their face." Scripture Job 6:13: "If indeed one were weighing" to [7:13]: "in my bed." Prophet Isaiah 40:1: "Comfort ye" to verse 8: "stands forever." Psalm 40 [41]: "I said, Lord, have mercy on me," say the responses in full.

Saturday. Feast of Saint Theodore the Warrior. On Saturday days of the fast, in place of the Hymn of Rest, say the "Oghormia" penitential hymns of the tone of the day, and [those of] the Mother of God and the Cross, Glory. After the Gospel: "For the souls of the deceased." Tone 3 [ah]: Of the Martyrs. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 6 [gk]: "The heavenly hosts." Magnificat [Mankunk] Tone 8 [dz]: "Who chose from the beginning." Midday Introit: "O Warrior." Psalm 115 [116:15]: "Precious is." Proverbs Wisdom 8:19: "I was a witty child" to 9:5: "and the son of your handmaid." Prophet Isaiah 62:6: "Thus says the Lord, and upon" to verse 9: "of my holiness." Epistle Romans 8:28: "But we know" to verse 39: "in Christ Jesus our Lord." Alleluia: "Let all rejoice." Gospel Matthew 10:16: "Behold, I send you" to verse 22: "he shall be saved." In the Evening, Hymn at the Tabernacle [Hambartsi] Tone 8 [dz]: "Who kept the law of holiness of the fast."

Second Sunday of Great Lent. Tone 8 [d]: "Who kept the law," with its proper canons. Psalm 112 [113], with voice. Refrain: "Blessed be." Response: "Praise." Gospel Luke 4:42: "And when it was day" to 5:11: "And followed him." Midday Psalm 64 [65]: "Praise becomes you." Prophet Isaiah 33:2: "Lord, have mercy on us" to verse 22: "and he will save us." Messedi, Psalm 75 [76]: "Make vows." Epistle Romans 12:1 [recte 13:8?]: "I beseech you" to 14:10 [recte 13:10]: "love is the fulfilling of the law." Alleluia: "Shout unto the Lord." Gospel Matthew 5:17: "Think not that I am come" to verse 48: "is perfect."

Monday. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 2 [ak]: "Your name, O Christ." Midday Messedi: Psalm 50 [51]: "Cast me not off." Scripture 1 Samuel 1:1: "And there was a man" to verse 23: "from your mouth." Proverbs 1:1: "To know wisdom" to verse 33: "from all evil." Prophet Jeremiah 1:1: "The word of God" to verse 10: "to build and to plant." Psalm 129 [130]: "Let your ears be," say in full.

Tuesday. Canticle of the Fathers [Harts] Tone 2 [ak]: "You who humbled." Midday Messedi: Psalm 127 [128]: "Blessed are all." Scripture 1 Samuel 1:23: "And the woman remained" to 2:26: "with God and men." Proverbs 2:1: "My son, if you receive" to 3:10: "shall overflow even more." Prophet Jeremiah 1:11: "And the word of the Lord came to me" to 2:3: "says the Lord." Psalm 26 [27]: "Hear, O Lord, my voice," say in full.
